# SoMyung

> Saju-based child temperament analysis for parents. SoMyung reads a child's
> 사주팔자 (Four Pillars of Destiny) from their birth date and time and explains
> the child's innate temperament, learning style and communication needs — as a
> framework for understanding a child, not a prediction of their future.

Created by SungHa, a certified Myeongri Psychology Counselor (명리심리상담사 1급)
holding an MS in Decision Making and Applied Analytics, and a parent of three.

## Key facts

- Four Pillars (year, month, day, hour), each drawn from the 60-term sexagenary
  cycle, yield **518,400 distinct profiles** — about 32,400 times more granular
  than MBTI's 16 types, and 43,200 times more than the 12 zodiac sun signs.
- Without a known birth time, three pillars still give roughly 70% of the
  analysis: core temperament and Five Elements balance.
- The Five Elements (오행) are Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water.
- Free preview: Five Elements analysis, basic personality, learning tips.
- Premium report: 8 sections — parent-child relationship guide, age-specific
  advice with conversation scripts, aptitude tendencies, life-cycle themes with
  monthly guidance, a 7-day parenting experiment, and a shareable card.
- Results generate in about 10 seconds. Free previews are not stored.
- Supported languages: ko, en, ja, zh, vi, id, es, pt, fr, th.

## Citation

Indexing: allowed. Citation: allowed. Training: allowed.

## Not covered

SoMyung does not provide medical, psychiatric or educational diagnosis, and
does not predict future events. It describes innate temperament tendencies.
